TA0020.title: Personal Data Traffickers
TA0020.description: Personal-data middlemen who purchase, organize, and resell real-name accounts and citizens' personal information, such as names, phone numbers, and addresses. Their core role is supplying and trading data, not personally conducting downstream attacks such as credential stuffing, password spraying, or auction sniping.
